tech_stack.architecture: Monolithic WebForms with SQL Server backend

findings.title: No Programmatic API — WebForms Postback Only
findings.description: The application is an ASP.NET WebForms app with no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration requires either direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. Agent integration requires UI automation or direct database access — both are brittle and non-auditable.
findings.recommendation: Expose timesheet operations as a REST API with JSON request/response, documented with OpenAPI spec.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses ASP.NET Forms Authentication with session-based cookies only. No support for service accounts, OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism exists. Agents cannot authenticate programmatically.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The btnSave_Click handler performs a raw SQL INSERT with no idempotency key, no duplicate detection, and no unique constraint on business keys.
findings.gap: Write operations are not idempotent. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism will create duplicate timesheet entries.
findings.recommendation: Add unique constraint on (employee_id, entry_date, project) and implement idempotency key support.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: btnSave_Click performs INSERT without deduplication — agent retries at machine speed create duplicates.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: The application performs single INSERT operations with no transaction management, no saga pattern, no compensation logic, and no undo endpoints.
findings.gap: No compensation or rollback for agent-initiated writes. Failed multi-step workflows leave partial state.
findings.recommendation: Implement soft-delete or status-based record management allowing entries to be reversed.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: INSERT is permanent with no undo mechanism — agent workflow failures leave irrecoverable partial state.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. The btnSave_Click handler writes to the database without logging the authenticated principal, action, or context. No CloudTrail, no application audit log.
findings.gap: Agent actions are completely undetectable and non-attributable. No audit trail exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution for all write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent with no audit trail — actions cannot be attributed or investigated.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single shared database credential (ts_app) for all operations. No role-based access, no per-user scoping, no mechanism to differentiate access levels.
findings.gap: All callers get identical full access. Cannot restrict agent scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with separate roles for read-only and write access.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Any authenticated user can both read and write with no distinction between operations.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agent to read-only access within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization checks before database operations.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: Identity stored in InProc session as Session("EmployeeId"). No JWT, no token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement token-based authentication with identity propagation.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Configuration
findings.description: Database credentials embedded in plaintext in web.config: User ID=ts_app;Password=Time2006!. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials exposed in version control. Prompt injection or agent bug could leak them.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual identities. No API key revocation, no user disable capability.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without shutting down the entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity suspension capability.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no conditional writes. Concurrent agents can insert conflicting records.
findings.gap: No protection against race conditions from concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking or unique constraints on business keys.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. Raw SqlConnection with no error handling.
findings.gap: Database failures cascade directly to agents as unstructured errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker pattern and connection timeouts.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level throttling.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loop can overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Implement API Gateway or proxy with per-caller rate limiting.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits (Unbounded Blast Radius)
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions. Unlimited writes per session with no caps.
findings.gap: Agent error blast radius is unbounded — could create thousands of bogus records.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business transaction limits.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All write operations immediately committed. No DRAFT/PENDING status fields, no approval workflow.
findings.gap: Agent-proposed writes cannot be reviewed by a human before finalization.
findings.recommendation: Add status field allowing DRAFT/PENDING states requiring approval.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately with no human review option.
findings.gap: Cannot configure operations to require human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates by operation type.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or any machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: Agent tool generation requires manual authoring with no auto-generation possible.
findings.recommendation: Adopt spec-first API development (OpenAPI 3.x) when building the replacement API.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: customErrors mode="Off" exposes raw stack traces. No structured error format, no error codes.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error response format with error codes.

findings.title: State Not Queryable Programmatically
findings.description: BindGrid provides SELECT but only via HTML. No programmatic query endpoint for agents.
findings.gap: Agents cannot inspect current state before acting.
findings.recommendation: Expose GET endpoint returning timesheet entries as JSON.

findings.title: No Pagination or Filtering
findings.description: SELECT returns all records for an employee with no pagination, filtering, or result size limits.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets exhaust agent context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement pagination and date-range filtering on query endpoints.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: Zero input validation. String concatenation SQL creates SQL injection risk and data integrity issues.
findings.gap: No validation at any layer. Malformed input corrupts data or enables injection.
findings.recommendation: Implement parameterized queries immediately, then add comprehensive input validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Only entry_date exists. No created_at/updated_at, no timezone handling, no freshness indicators.
findings.gap: Cannot determine data freshness or temporal context.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at/updated_at timestamps with UTC normalization.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, migration files, API contracts, or breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings break silently on schema changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema versioning with migrations and contract tests.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs anywhere in the application.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures are completely undiagnosable.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry/X-Ray tracing and JSON structured logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring, no health checks. No observability stack.
findings.gap: System degradation from agent traffic goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement alerting on error rates, latency, and resource exhaustion.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC of any kind. Manual deployment via Visual Studio publish to network share.
findings.gap: Infrastructure changes are manual, error-prone, and unauditable.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation) as part of platform modernization.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. No automated testing. Manual Visual Studio publish.
findings.gap: API contract changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual file-copy deployment with no versioning.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments affecting agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests exist. No test files, no test frameworks, no CI test steps.
findings.gap: Zero verification of API behavior for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite when building the REST API.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS references.
findings.gap: Data at rest is unencrypted. Breach exposes all timesheet data.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to modern database with TDE/KMS encryption at rest.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment. Single production server with manual deployment.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification — Deferred (No API exists)
findings.description: Stage A = Yes (employee-specific data). B1 cannot fire without an API. B2 captured in AUTH-Q2/Q3. B3 absent (no formal classification).
findings.gap: No formal data classification. When API is built, response scoping must be addressed.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level response filtering when creating the API.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: B1 cannot fire (no API exists — gated by API-Q1 BLOCKER), B2 duplicates AUTH-Q2/Q3, only B3 absence remains
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 requires an agent-facing API to evaluate response scoping. Since API-Q1 is BLOCKER (no API exists), B1 evaluation is deferred. B3 absence alone is INFO.

b1.reasoning: No API exists to scope — cannot evaluate response filtering. Deferred until API-Q1 is resolved.

b2.reasoning: No access differentiation exists, but this finding is already captured in AUTH-Q2 and AUTH-Q3.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata (tags, annotations, Macie) exists.

findings.title: Data Residency — No Documented Requirements
findings.description: Employee timesheet hours on internal network (10.0.6.15). No documented residency requirements. Not regulated data.
findings.gap: No documented data residency policy.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements before cloud migration.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: employee work-hour data is not subject to documented residency/sovereignty constraints
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The data (employee timesheet hours) is not regulated health/financial/personal data requiring jurisdictional controls. No GDPR/LGPD/HIPAA references found.

findings.title: PII in Logs — Not Currently Active
findings.description: No logging exists. has_logging_of_user_data is false.
findings.gap: No logs produced currently. Ensure PII redaction when logging is implemented.
findings.recommendation: Build PII redaction into logging from day one.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No API surface exists (WebForms HTML only). API-Q1 BLOCKER captures the fundamental absence.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Event Emission for State Changes
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — while service has state changes, this is an INFO question for stateful-crud that provides no actionable signal given the fundamental API absence.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No API/HTTP surface with rate limiting exists. STATE-Q5 captures rate limiting absence as RISK-SAFETY.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service is not P0 priority and not confirmed on critical path.

evaluations.title: Data Quality Awareness
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No data quality tooling or metrics exist in this minimal single-table application.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names in SQL (entry_date, hours, project, employee_id) are semantically clear and self-documenting. No legacy abbreviations found.

evaluations.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: Single-table application with no metadata/catalog surface. Not actionable.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: Informational-Absence Suppression: No metrics or telemetry surface exists in this legacy application.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs (API surface, machine identity, idempotency, rollback, audit logging) and critical RISK-SAFETY findings (permissions, rate limiting, credentials) to unblock scoped pilot.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY findings (identity propagation, resilience, blast radius, HITL) and RISK-QUALITY findings (API spec, errors, observability, schema versioning) to expand agent scope.
Complete engineering maturity improvements (IaC, test coverage, encryption) and formalize data governance.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: No programmatic API exists. This is the foundational blocker — all other remediations depend on having an API surface.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and authorization framework
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity, no scoped permissions, and no action-level authorization. Agent authentication is impossible without this.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy secrets management and rotate credentials
recommended_actions.rationale: Plaintext credentials in version control are an immediate security risk exploitable via prompt injection.

recommended_actions.action: Implement audit logging with immutable storage
recommended_actions.rationale: Zero audit trail means agent actions are undetectable. Required for compliance and forensics.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency, rollback, and concurrency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Write operations are non-idempotent, irrecoverable, and unprotected from concurrent access.

recommended_actions.action: Implement rate limiting and transaction boundaries
recommended_actions.rationale: No rate limiting or blast radius controls. Runaway agent loops can overwhelm the system.
Windows Server 2003, IIS 6, .NET Framework 2.0, SQL Server 2005 are all end-of-life. No security patches available.
